portfolioIncident.title: Hypothetical cbBTC 30% depeg relative to BTC
portfolioIncident.whatHappened: Analyst replay of a 30% relative cbBTC/BTC price decline. No live depeg was detected.
portfolioIncident.whyItMatters: cbBTC backs funded Morpho markets beneath these positions. The loss and immediate exit gap below are calculated stress estimates, not observed losses or withdrawal quotes.
portfolioIncident.conditionalMaxAssumption: Hypothetical 100% permanent loss of every uniquely attributed dollar; not an estimate from the 30% cbBTC price shock.
portfolioIncident.estimationNote: SIMULATED 30% collateral shock. Suppliers: market loss rate = borrow ÷ supply × 25% near LLTV × max(0, 1 − 0.70 ÷ LLTV) × 50% unrecovered; immediate exit gap uses exposure × (1 − market liquidity ÷ supply). Borrowers: collateral value decline = tracked collateral × 30%; repayment-dependent collateral = min(tracked collateral, assumed debt ÷ (LLTV × 0.70)). Vault withdrawals may differ.
analystMustVerify: Whether cbBTC actually deviated from BTC
